name: card
useFor: Use the default card for a block of facts about one thing (a site, a source, a requirement): a 16px regular title, a muted description, Fog tags or values in CardContent and an action in CardAction or CardFooter. Use muted for a group of values inside a Bone panel, and inverse for the one card that leads (the best fit). Put cards on the canvas; inside a Bone panel prefer rules over nested cards.
constraints: A cut corner anywhere but the top-left
More than one inverse card on a screen
Nesting cards more than one level
source: Figma UI · Agent chat (443:433): the message panel's cut frame, at the product scale
